text:
Alex: quick heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to add an embedding sharding example + guidance for model limits in the model catalog. aiming to cover: when to shard, target shard sizes, and an SDK snippet for v3. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/xxx :eyes:
Sara: thanks — will review. can you include a note about per-shard seq/embedding-size limits? we should be explicit about total token footprint vs per-request limits.
Andre: fyi runtime has some caveats for quantized models with sharding (kv cache layout). we'll need a compatibility note for Nebula3b-quant and Zephyr-mini variants. i can paste a short blurb.
Kevin: also add a quick bench row (p50 latency, tokens/sec) for 1-shard vs 4-shard for the typical 512-d embed workload. customers always ask for numbers.
Alex: good call. i'll add a small table and link to the bench artifact. thinking of wording like: "Start with 1 shard; increase when throughput < X TPS or latency SLOs violated; prefer even shard sizes."
Sara: for the SDK snippet, here's a compact python example you can drop in:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
rc = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
emb = rc.embeddings.create(model='nebula3b', input=['doc1','doc2'], shard_config={"num_shards":4, "target_shard_size":256})
print(emb[0]['vector'][:8])
```
Sara: i'll also push an equivalent TS/JS snippet in the same PR. please check param names — we debated `target_shard_size` vs `max_shard_tokens` earlier.
Andre: link my runtime note under "compatibility notes" — paste: "Quantized KV layout may increase cold-start latency when requests touch multiple shards; prefer fewer shards for small-batch workloads."
Alex: added Andre's blurb and the bench link. i stubbed a new row in model-card limits table: "Embedding shard recommended: 1–8 (start at 1); recommended shard size: 128–512 vectors" — can you sanity-check?
Kevin: numbers look fine. for the bench row, can we add a short footnote: "measured on Dedicated g5.2x with 512-d vectors, batch=8". customers appreciate reproducibility.
Sara: i'll fix copy and add an anchor id so other docs can link directly: `#embed-sharding-guidance`. also will run the linter on the snippet.
docs-bot: CI started for PR #xxx — lint, linkcheck, and snippet-tests queued.
Alex: thanks all — tagging @Andre @Kevin for final thumbs. target to merge by EOD PT. :calendar:
Andre: quick thumbs, left one inline comment about phrasing.
Kevin: 👍 will approve once the footnote is in.
docs-bot: CI passed — linkcheck OK, snippet-tests OK (python, js).
docs-bot: PR merged into main by Alex (3052109999).
Alex: merged — will follow up with a small changelog entry and a redirect from the old quickstart embed page to the new guidance.
Sara: great. i'll also add a short migration note in the SDK docs: "If you were relying on single-request size > 1024 vectors, check shard config and runtime compatibility."
Alex: closing thread. if anyone spots a wording issue, please open a tiny follow-up PR. :sparkles:
